waiting area.summary: In this room, looking from the entrance, three colorful bohemian style sofas made with plush velvet and adorned with intricate embroidery and tassels are arranged in a row, each spaced 1.5 meters apart. The first sofa faces a warm vintage wooden coffee table made with reclaimed oak, which holds an earthy handcrafted ceramic lamp with organic details, while a hanging wicker light fixture softly diffuses light above it. Two natural woven rattan chairs, lightweight and elegantly curved, flank a second vintage wooden coffee table, with one chair opposite the other. Five vibrant colorful floor cushions with geometric designs are scattered near the sofas and chairs, adding a playful touch. Above each sofa, a neutral macrame wall hanging with intricate knots adds texture, while a vibrant hand painted tapestry with bold brushstrokes hangs on the wall behind the first sofa, opposite a rustic artisanal wall mirror. A colorful mosaic side table with ceramic tiles sits next to one rattan chair, holding a green indoor potted plant in a hand-painted pot. Two warm vintage wooden coffee tables each have a woven seagrass basket underneath, and five bright decorative throw pillows with floral embroidery rest on the sofas and chairs. An antique brass floor lamp stands beside the third sofa, accompanied by another potted plant, while additional plants are placed near the chairs and sofas, enhancing the bohemian charm. Two earthy handcrafted ceramic lamps sit on the coffee tables, completing the eclectic, harmonious space.
